title: People illustration / Isometric pose progression

location.series: IBM Design Language / alternate tab states
location.label: Isometric

slide_intent: Let a shared skeleton support different actions, because believable pose gives a character meaning beyond its surface appearance.
strategic_value: Consistent construction across walking and phone-use figures can help IBM illustrate varied human activity within one visual system.
demonstration: Two pairs compare skeletal construction with finished colored characters: a walking woman at left and a person holding a phone at right.
practical_value: Test a pose in the structural stage before committing to the final silhouette and clothing.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying People page explains that body language, clothing and props add familiarity and help express the character’s role.
reference_purposes.Application: The paired skeleton/final views demonstrate transferring the common human construction into two different poses.
